Lecture Overview:
How does retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) work, and do frontier models still need it? In this Stanford CS329Z: Engineering AI Agents lecture, Stanford professor Diyi Yang walks through the full RAG pipeline: chunking and contextual retrieval, RAPTOR and GraphRAG, vector search with HNSW, BM25 vs. dense retrieval (DPR), hybrid search, rerankers and ColBERT, and agentic RAG methods like Self-RAG, CRAG, and Search-R1.
Speaker: Diyi Yang
